IX, 2) <he>ע׳ בגלגלא</he> clouds (rolling) in the sphere; (oth. opin.) <he>ע׳ דשפכי מיא וכ׳</he> clouds (bottles, v. <cite ref="P01000">preced.</cite>) that empty the waters from one to the other; ib. <he>ע׳ חלחולי וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="H01019"><he>חַלְחֵל</he></cite>; <he>בריק ברקא ומנהמי ע׳ וכ׳</he> the lightning flashes and the clouds rumble, and then comes the rain.
<cite ref="Taanit 25a:19">Taan. 25ᵃ</cite> <he>שמעינהו לע׳ דאמרי נשדי מיטרא וכ׳</he> Ms. M. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) overheard the clouds say, let us cast rain on Ammon &c.
